protocol.percentiles: Initial navigation n=6, interactions n=10; nearest rank p95=max. HTTP burst completion uses 10 waves; requests within a wave are correlated. Complete HTTP time includes gzip decode/JSON validation in one Node client. Pool counts are nominal 25ms same-role samples, not proof of maximum possible concurrency or production saturation.
